accepted_scope_rows.ScopeItemStatement: Store workflow definitions, human decisions and accepted records as ordinary files in the user's project or workspace.
Treat harness session storage as operational rather than authority for human acts.
Keep compact project run records that link host receipts, hashes and origin evidence rather than copying them.
Bind each recorded human act to its identified content, scope and purpose.
Show a content-bound human act as lapsed when its bound content changes.
Record host-agent runs using the shared format linked to host receipts.
Run records identify workflow/version, conversation, autonomy, requested operations/outcomes, receipt references, actual human acts and model.
